title: ANH9 - Bài tập Hoàn thành câu - Đề 3

questions.content:
Mark the letter A, B, C or D on your answer sheet to indicate the correct answer to each of the following questions.
(Chọn đáp án đúng cho từng câu hỏi dưới đây.)
1. The government has started a new road safety campaign in order to reduce the number of road __________.
Parents should teach their children to __________ decisions about crossing the road.
My car broke __________ on the way to Madrid and we have to put up a tent to stay overnight.
The ending of the film was so __________ I couldn’t imagine it!
Dinosaurs are believed __________ to millions of years ago.
Nobody was injured in the accident last night, __________.
A lot of people __________ by AIDS recently, and I wish nobody would die anymore.
After __________ by the police, the man admitted __________ the car but denied driving at 100 miles an hour.
I found the plot of the movie __________. It doesn’t surprise me at all!
More and more plants and flowers in this area are found __________ from the effect of contamination.
Benny __________ the same old jacket since he __________ here.
Some people expect to make mistakes in their studies and are capable __________ benefiting from their mistakes.
Lila still felt delighted __________ just a few of her friends sent her birthday presents.
His illness made it __________ for him to work effectively.
My cousin hasn’t made a decision __________ to the trip to Mexico next year.
Hydro and nuclear power are renewable and__________. They can generate a great deal of energy.
It is said that only one percent of solar energy __________ the Earth can supply enough power for the whole world’s population.
Non-renewable energy sources will __________ someday.
I was made __________ back home early when I went out in the evening.
If Bella __________ walk home in the rain, she _________ a terrible cold last Friday.
options: A. hadn’t had - wouldn’t have caught
B. hadn’t had to - wouldn’t have caught
C. didn’t have to - wouldn’t catch
D. wouldn’t have to - had caught
